content:
alex: FYI customer hit rerank endpoint; got 422 and all scores 0. They pasted the example from Console/cURL docs.

support-bot: <automated> ticket #8342 created, escalating to eng if not resolved in 24h

morgan: can you paste the exact curl they used?

alex: sure — this is verbatim from the Console copy button (note single quotes):
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"best processing lib","candidates":["libone","libtwo",],"top_k":3}'
```

alex: response was:
```json
{"error":"Unprocessable Entity","message":"Unexpected token ',' in JSON at position 123"}
```

jess: ah — there's a trailing comma after "libtwo" in the candidates array and the docs example uses single quotes around the -d payload which breaks on Powershell. docs copy combined two mistakes.

sam: repro'd on mac bash and on Windows PowerShell. On PowerShell the single quotes get stripped and curl sees the braces wrong; result is 422. On mac the trailing comma triggers parse error. Also saw another customer where scores returned as [0,0,0] because they sent candidates as a stringified array (double-encoded).

morgan: can you paste the corrected curl that works cross-shell?

alex: fixed working examples:
Bash (mac/linux):
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"best processing lib","candidates":["libone","libtwo"],"top_k":3}'
```
PowerShell (use double quotes and escape inner quotes):
```powershell
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $env:API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"query\":\"best processing lib\",\"candidates\":[\"libone\",\"libtwo\"],\"top_k\":3}"
```

alex: also reproduce for the "scores all 0" case — cause was sending `candidates` as `"[\"a\",\"b\"]"` (a string). Rerank expects a JSON array of strings.

docs-team: thanks — we'll update the Console copy button to: 1) strip trailing commas, 2) provide both bash and PowerShell examples, 3) add a validation check in UI that warns if a payload contains trailing commas or stringified arrays. PR incoming.

morgan: QA note — add a quick server-side validation error message for stringified arrays (e.g., "candidates must be array of strings, not string") so support can triage faster.

jess: opened internal doc with repro steps + minimal payload. attaching here: https://internal.redwood/docs/rerank-repro-8342 :thumbsup:

alex: closing loop with the customer — will link updated console snippet once PR merged. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
